# App Shell

**Figma:** Codebase Platform shell (Sidebar + topbar + content) and the Breakpoint & Grids variables  
**Import:** `import { AppShell } from "@zen/design-system";`

The frame of a web app: Sidebar navigation, a sticky top bar and the main content with a skip link. From 1024px the Sidebar sits beside the content; below, it becomes a drawer opened from the top bar's menu button.

## Use it for
- Every signed-in web app screen (dashboards, admin, settings).
- Apps that must work from phone to desktop with one navigation.

## Use something else for
- Phone-only apps → TopNavigation + BottomNavigation inside ZenProvider typography="mobile".
- Marketing pages → Container + your own header.
- A modal flow → Dialog or SidePanel.

## Figma → React
| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Navigation | `sidebar` | a <Sidebar>; below 1024px it moves into a drawer (scrim, Escape and choosing a page close it) |
| Top bar | `header · headerActions` | header on the left (grows): Search, breadcrumbs; headerActions on the right: notifications, help, account menu; the drawer's menu button comes first on small screens |
| Canvas | `canvas` | default · alt (white page) · flat (pair with Sidebar background="flat") |
| Breakpoint | `layout` | auto (follows ZenProvider's breakpoint) · sidebar · drawer |
| — | `navOpen · onNavOpenChange · navLabel · mainId · footer` | controlled drawer · its name · the skip-link target · a sticky bottom bar |

## Props
Generated from the TypeScript source; full JSON in `docs/api/app-shell.json`.

### AppShell
The frame of a web app: navigation, a sticky top bar and the main content, with a skip link. From 1024px the Sidebar sits beside the content; below, it becomes a drawer (scrim, Escape and choosing a page close it). <AppShell sidebar={<Sidebar … />} header={<Search … />}> `<Container>`<PageHeader title="Team members" /> …`</Container>` `</AppShell>`

Also accepts `Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "children">`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sidebar` | `ReactNode` | — | Left navigation, usually `<Sidebar>`. Below 1024px it moves into a drawer opened from the header's menu button. |
| `header` | `ReactNode` | — | Top bar content on the left (it grows): search, breadcrumbs. On small screens the drawer's menu button comes first. |
| `headerActions` | `ReactNode` | — | Top bar actions on the right: notifications, help, the account menu. |
| `footer` | `ReactNode` | — | A sticky bar at the bottom of the main column, e.g. BottomNavigation on phones. |
| `canvas` | `"default" \| "alt" \| "flat"` | `"default"` | Page background layer: default Canvas, alt (a white page) or flat (pair it with Sidebar background="flat"). |
| `navOpen` | `boolean` | — | Drawer state when controlled (small screens). |
| `defaultNavOpen` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `onNavOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` | — |  |
| `navLabel` | `string` | — | Accessible name of the navigation drawer and its menu button's target. Default: the locale's “Navigation”. |
| `mainId` | `string` | — | id of `<main>`, the target of the "Skip to content" link. Default: a generated unique id. |
| `layout` | `"auto" \| "sidebar" \| "drawer"` | `"auto"` | Force the layout; by default it follows ZenProvider's breakpoint (tablet and mobile use the drawer). |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | The page. |

## ✅ Do
- Put one AppShell at the root of each signed-in screen, inside ZenProvider.
- Give the page a Container with a PageHeader as its first child.
- Keep the top bar light: Search, notifications and the account menu; page actions belong in the PageHeader.
- Let layout follow the breakpoint; force layout only for previews and tests.

## ❌ Don't
- Don't build your own sidebar + main flex layout.
- Don't put primary page actions in the top bar.
- Don't nest AppShells.

## Accessibility
- Renders a "Skip to content" link that becomes visible on focus and targets `<main>`.
- The drawer is a modal dialog: focus moves into it, Escape closes it and focus returns to the menu button.
- `<main>` is focusable (tabindex=-1) so the skip link lands on it.

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
| `interaction/controlled-needs-handler` | warn | A controlled prop comes with its change handler (month + onMonthChange, value + onValueChange, open + onOpenChange, pageSize + onPageSizeChange…): without it nothing can change the value and the control is frozen, e.g. a DatePicker whose Previous/Next do nothing. Bare booleans (a fixed preview) and `x ? true : undefined` pins pass. | `zen-allow-controlled-handler: <reason>` |
